subject: HS2 tunnel work passes halfway point
intro: The tunnel boring machines working on HS2's Euston section have reached the halfway mark. Work continues with spoil trains now moving material away from the site.

news.title: HS2’s tunnel boring machines are halfway to Euston
news.excerpt: The two machines digging HS2’s tunnels from Old Oak Common are now halfway to Euston, having drilled 2.25 miles of their 4.5-mile journey. The TBM being pushed up to the tunnel starting site in March
